title: 부탁의 세기: 누구에게, 얼마나 부드럽게 말해요?
objective: You can tell how strong a Korean request is and soften it with 혹시, 좀, a cushion phrase, and a question ending.
summary: Korean requests range from direct to very soft, depending on the relationship and the size of the favor.
note: The requests on this sheet go from casual to very polite. Choose one based on who you are talking to and how big the favor is.

task.title: Read and judge requests
task.line: Decide how soft each request is and who it fits, then complete or build the requests.

sections.heading: Build a soft request, piece by piece

steps.en: Sorry, but… (a cushion before the favor)

sections.heading: From direct to soft: endings and softeners

items.text: Very direct. Use it only with family, close friends, or younger people.
The standard polite request for shops, staff, and everyday small favors.
Asks if the person is willing, so it sounds softer than 주세요.
Very soft. Use it for bigger favors or with a boss, teacher, or client.
Sounds like pleading. Use it with close people, not in formal situations.
items.example: 오늘만 차 좀 빌려주면 안 돼?

items.text: Works like 'please'; it makes almost any request sound less pushy.
Shows you don't take a yes for granted, so the listener feels free to say no.
A cushion phrase before asking a stranger or interrupting someone.
items.example: 죄송한데요, 자리 좀 바꿔 주실 수 있어요?

sections.heading: Reading tips: how strong does it sound?
paragraphs: In Korean, a request usually gets softer as it gets longer and turns into a question. 주세요 is polite, but if you use it to ask a boss or teacher for a big favor, it can sound like an order. For big favors, add 혹시 or 좀 and use 주시겠어요? or 주실 수 있을까요?

exercises: Which request is the softest? ① 가방 좀 들어 줘요. ② 가방 좀 들어 주실 수 있을까요? ③ 가방 좀 들어 줘.
Is this request OK in the situation? Write Yes or No. ① To your boss: 오늘 보고서 확인해 줘. ② To your younger sister: 리모컨 좀 줘. ③ To a stranger on the bus: 죄송한데, 가방 좀 치워 주시겠어요?
Fill in each blank with 혹시 or 좀: ① ____ 내일 시간 돼요? ② 여기에 사인 ____ 해 주세요.
Put the pieces in order to make a soft request to a stranger: 주실 수 있을까요? / 죄송한데요, / 사진 좀 / 혹시 / 찍어
Make this request softer for a professor. Use -아/어 주실 수 있을까요?: 추천서 좀 써 줘요.
answers: 가방 좀 들어 주실 수 있을까요?
① No ② Yes ③ Yes
죄송한데요, 혹시 사진 좀 찍어 주실 수 있을까요?
추천서 좀 써 주실 수 있을까요? (교수님, 혹시 추천서 좀 써 주실 수 있을까요?)
